## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.26

This release restores the fast Organizer queue path while keeping preview-based queueing.

### Changed

- Organizer now has both "Add current" and "Add preview" queue buttons.
- "Add current" queues the current Organizer settings without requiring Preview.
- "Add preview" remains available after a successful Preview and snapshots the finalized preview plan, including manual track selection and drag order.

### Notes

- Use "Add current" with the automatic duplicate/probable duplicate options for a faster no-preview queue workflow.
- Use "Add preview" when you want to inspect and manually adjust tracks before queueing.
